title: Place API routes with CRUD and typeahead endpoints
description: Create Express routes and controller for all Place endpoints: full CRUD (list, get, create, update, soft-delete) plus a dedicated typeahead endpoint for stop form autocomplete. All endpoints scoped to organization via auth middleware. Typeahead returns lightweight results with facility type and contact info for display in autocomplete dropdowns. Note: dispatch-api service key not yet in packages.json — depends on foundation BE-001 creating the API package.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/places returns paginated list with default limit 25, max 100, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasMore }

GET /api/v1/places supports query params: ?search= (matches name, city, state), ?facilityType= (enum filter), ?state= (2-char filter), ?contactId= (UUID filter), ?sort=&order= (default createdAt desc)
GET /api/v1/places/:id returns single place with all fields; returns 404 if not found or soft-deleted
POST /api/v1/places returns 201 with created place including auto-populated lat/lng from geo lookup
POST validates request body with Yup schema; returns 400 ValidationError with field-level messages on failure
PATCH /api/v1/places/:id returns 200 with updated place; re-runs geo lookup if city or state changed (unless geoSource=MANUAL)
DELETE /api/v1/places/:id soft-deletes (sets deletedAt); returns 204 on success, 404 if not found
GET /api/v1/places/typeahead?q=&limit=10 returns array of { id, name, city, state, facilityType, contactName, contactId } — minimum 2 chars required for q, returns 400 if q < 2 chars
Typeahead searches name, city, state fields; also matches places whose associated contact companyName matches the query
All endpoints require auth middleware; places scoped to organizationId matching authenticated user's orgId
ADMIN and DISPATCHER can create/edit places; only ADMIN can delete (per PRD role matrix)
VIEWER role has read-only access to GET endpoints
Routes registered under /api/v1/places in the Express app
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
